data.name: From The Dark
data.detailed_description:
A tense, procedurally generated dungeon crawler where the only source of light is you. Trade concealment for visibility, exchange light for strength, or lose speed for endurance. Regardless of what you choose, survival isn't guaranteed.

FEATURES

  • Master specialized "Light Aura" items

    • Each revealing the room in different ways: soft light, LiDAR, scanlines, echolocation

    • Every attack counts. With every magical power you use, you pay with light

  • Wield a wide arsenal of hand-crafted & unique weapons

    • Melee, ranged, and magic, each with their own strengths & playstyles

  • Juggle between hundreds of items, ranging from swords to trinkets for passive stat boosts

  • Conquer three distinct, playable regions

    • Each with exclusive items, enemies, and styles

  • Battle a large variety of enemies

  • Explore numerous randomized rooms

  • Speak to a multitude of NPCs

    • Upgrade your gear, learn secrets, and even gamble in-game currency

  • Dance on the edge of life and death with the Permadeath option

LIGHT AURA

They said gods didn't exist. They were wrong, and the most vicious took the very resource needed to survive: light. Now, you're left to channel whatever magic you have into a fragile glow to guide your path. The more you shine, the more you can see, but the easier they can find you. Look for a good balance and use the darkness to your advantage.

Magic is costly. Every spell you cast temporarily spends Light Aura. Too much at once, and you could go blind.

ITEMS

Chests and crates litter the place, each containing money or a weapon. Everything you find has its own use, strengthening you in various ways. Some will let you conjure magic, others will cut deep into the flesh of your foes, and a few might even keep you breathing. Find 250+ items to fight and survive with. 

THE LABYRINTHS

A gray, abandoned maze of brick walls and tiles. With no landmarks, it can be easy to lose your way. Cursed souls drift eternally while rogue machines lurk around every corner, forcing a dangerous environment. Weapons here are plentiful, but the lack of magic is suffocating. The darkness ascends from below. Something has to be down here...

THE BURIED DESERT

Buried in old, forgotten temples lie weapons charged with a magical force, though traversing the region may prove difficult. Otherworldly beings are constantly on the hunt as sections get locked down, and one turn could lead to certain death. The ghost of a civilization waits to be found. There's no telling how deep these ruins go.

THE GREEN VALLEYS

Once full of life, the valleys now conceal hidden traps and small creatures under the thick foliage. Deadly predators stalk through the tall grass, using the rugged terrain to their advantage. Even in the darkness, life radiates through the forest, burning itself into equipment left to be discovered.

THE VILLAGE

An endangered sanctuary at the heart of chaos; the residents just don't know it yet. Here, upgrade your weapons, refill your supplies, and recuperate before facing the horrors ahead. The four paths surrounding the village all lead into the unknown that grows restless.

data.short_description: A tense, procedurally generated dungeon crawler where your only advantage is the dark. Face relentless enemies and find a way to reclaim the light that was stolen.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Celeron N4120
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 600
  • Storage: 650 MB available space
